name: Lower Merion Eruv
covers: Bala Cynwyd, Merion, Narberth, Penn Valley and Wynnewood.

marks.name: Crossing E
marks.note: Under the North Wynnewood Bridge. This is the arched stone bridge going under the train tracks near the Narberth playground.

marks.name: Lankenau Hospital Route
marks.note: Although most of the sidewalks on City Ave are outside both eruvin, the sidewalk between Wynnewood Road and Lancaster Avenue on the Main Line side is now inside the Main Line eruv to allow people to walk from Lower Merion to Lankenau Hospital. However, the sidewalk going over the RR bridge just south of Merion Road is NOT included; to get to Lankenau from within the Eruv of Lower Merion it is necessary to go under the railroad at the Merion train station, go to Wynnewood Road, turn left to City Avenue, and then turn right on City Avenue and right again on Lancaster Road.

marks.name: Winter 2026 Reroute Alert
marks.note: A note that the eruv boundary now turns at Bala Ave and no longer follows City Line Ave at that point. The sidewalk on the Bala Park side of Bala Ave is no longer within the eruv boundary up until Bala Park. The sidewalk on the OPPOSITE SIDE of Bala Park is included in the eruv boundary UP UNTIL this point

marks.name: Fall 2025 Reroute Alert
marks.note: Note that the eruv boundary runs along Bala Ave from City Line Ave and turns just before the park fence. The park in its entirety, including the entrance to the park is within the eruv.

marks.name: Fall 2025 Reroute Alert
marks.note: Despite the eruv reroute, the entire Kelly property and access points are within the eruv boundary.

marks.name: Fall 2025 Reroute Alert
marks.note: Note that the newly built trail extension is no longer in the eruv boundary (past Union Ave approaching City Line Ave).

marks.name: Winter 2026 Reroute Alert
marks.note: A note that the eruv no longer continues on City Avenue past CVS Pharmacy. It turns on Bryn Mawr Avenue and continues BEHIND Firestone, Enterprise, and the French School, which are no longer included within the eruv. As a result, one cannot carry on Bryn Mawr all the way to City Ave.

name: University City Eruv
covers: Penn, Drexel and the West Philadelphia neighborhood around them, including HUP and CHOP. Joins the Center City Eruv over the South Street Bridge.

marks.name: Connector to Center City
marks.note: There is a connector to the Center City Eruv allowing carrying into Center City only over the South St. Bridge. The connector is supervised by the Center City Eruv.
